title: Aligning Attention with Human Rationales for Self-Explaining Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating unintended bias against protected demographic groups using Generalized Mean Bias (GMB) metrics (GMB-Subgroup AUC, GMB-BPSN AUC, GMB-BNSP AUC). This measures the model's ability to distinguish between toxic and normal posts containing identity terms, assessing both false positive rates on normal mentions of identities and false negative rates on targeted toxic posts.
